meta.title: An unused staging queue is billed until 10 December: someone needs to say keep it or drop it
meta.lede: A staging queue in the demo account has had no traffic for ninety days. Its reservation renews on 10 December. Nobody has said who owns it. Ticket [r2].
meta.foot: Source: a made-up scenario for tests.

deadline.ask_by_note: last sensible day to ask the owner

options.title: Ask the owner, then drop it
options.pro: One question, a record left behind
options.note: No answer by 6 Dec means drop it.

options.title: Renew on purpose
options.con: Needs an owner and a reason
options.note: Only if an owner confirms a planned use.

why: Dropping an unowned queue is cheap to undo, while renewing it quietly adds a cost nobody tracks. The one real risk is a hidden user, and a single question closes it [r1].

needs.need: Any producer or consumer still pointing at it
Keep or drop, in one line

reply.text: Re DEMO-12: the staging queue shows no traffic for 90 days. Unless the owner replies by 6 Dec, please drop it.
